# Medellín Concierge

> Medellín Concierge S.A.S. is a property management company in Medellín, Colombia, managing Airbnb / short-term and long-term rentals for local and foreign owners in El Poblado, Laureles, Envigado and Sabaneta. Bilingual team (English and Spanish), office in El Poblado.

## Key facts

- Services: Property management, Airbnb management, Short-term rental management, Long-term rental management, Channel management, Vacation rental management
- Areas served: Medellín, El Poblado, Laureles, Envigado, Sabaneta, Colombia
- Fees: Basic plan 12% + IVA of rental income for long stays (30+ nights), 17% + IVA for short stays; Premium plan 15% + IVA long stays, 20% + IVA short stays. No upfront fees. Premium also pays the owner's property tax, HOA fees, utilities and internet, with a monthly accounting report.
- Google rating: 4.7 out of 5 from 65 Google reviews (checked Nov 2026; profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z1Edu7BPoXGiPpqh8)
- Office: Cl. 10 #42-28, Oficina 15, El Poblado, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia (https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z1Edu7BPoXGiPpqh8)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +57 304 277 3864
- Email: sales@medellinconcierge.net
- NIT (Colombian tax ID): 901564260-7
- Website (English): https://www.medellinconcierge.net/ | Spanish: https://www.medellinconcierge.net/es/
- Profiles: https://www.airbnb.com/users/show/446836447, https://www.instagram.com/medellin.concierge/, https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z1Edu7BPoXGiPpqh8, https://www.facebook.com/luxmedellinconcierge, https://www.linkedin.com/company/medellin-concierge-sas/

## Furnished rentals (for renters)

Medellín Concierge also rents the furnished apartments it manages directly to guests, by the month (30+ nights) and by the night, booked direct. As of 23 November 2026 (from our HostFlow listings feed): 17 homes by the month from $6.900.000 to $20.700.000 COP a month, 15 by the night from $85.000 COP, plus a one-time cleaning fee ($80.000 to $230.000 COP). Areas: El Poblado (15), Medellín (5), Envigado (4), Laureles (2), Sabaneta (2), Barbosa (1), Ciudad del Río (1), Guatapé (1) and Guayabal (1). To ask or book, email sales@medellinconcierge.net with dates, number of guests, budget and preferred area, or WhatsApp +57 304 277 3864; we answer in English or Spanish and confirm availability and the total price in writing. For nightly stays we manage the RNT, SIRE (foreign guests reported to Migración Colombia) and TRA of the properties we manage (as of November 2026); ask us for the apartment's RNT number. Foreigners can rent in Colombia (Constitution, Article 100); unfurnished leases usually ask for a Colombian co-signer (fiador), so most newcomers start with a furnished apartment booked direct; ask us what the one you like requires. General information, not legal advice.
